name: lablend
description: LabLend: lends lab equipment, with the 2 items / 7 days hard rule.

scripts.postinstall: cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.build: cd frontend && npm run build && cd ../backend && npm run build
scripts.start: cd frontend && npm run build && cd ../backend && npm start
scripts.eval: cd backend && npm run build && node dist/evals/run.js
scripts.mcp:config: cd backend && npm run build && node dist/mcp/print-config.js
